biggest_catch: This is gambling, not income: event contracts can lose 100%, the promo credit is non-withdrawable trading credit only, and there is no guaranteed payout of any kind.
catches: Prediction markets are gambling: contracts settle at $1 (win) or $0 (loss), and positions can lose 100%.

The bonus is issued as non-withdrawable trading credit, not cash; affiliates report a 1x trade-through requirement before profits tied to it become withdrawable, and the credit expires about 7 days after issuance (affiliate terms, not official).

The claimed '$55 after $25 trade volume' is an affiliate-code offer (codes seen: WTOP55, ACTION55); other affiliates advertise different amounts ($25 flat, or randomized tiers $15/$35/$75/$100/$500), so the exact amount is not a stable official Kalshi offer.

No official Kalshi promo terms page confirming the $55 figure could be loaded this session (kalshi.com/tc fetch failed); Kalshi's own fee schedule PDF exists at kalshi.com/docs/kalshi-fee-schedule.pdf but was not fetchable this session.
Registration requires full KYC including SSN and photo ID, since Kalshi is a CFTC-regulated designated contract market.
Availability is state-limited (affiliates report exclusions including AZ, IL, MA, MD, MI, MT, NV, OH, WA - must be confirmed in official terms).

Fees erode returns: Kalshi charges a per-trade taker fee = round up(0.07 x contracts x price x (1-price)), per the official fee schedule quoted in multiple sources; $2 per bank withdrawal reported by third parties.
Addiction risk: this is real-money event trading with uncertain outcomes.
